mainRoof.notes: Main gable roof with ridge along the front, gable ends on left and right. Garage roof is a lower, narrower gable with ridge in the same direction, ending in its own gable on the right. One front cross gable / gabled wall dormer (flush with the front wall) left of centre, with valleys into the front slope. Front slope extends lower over the entrance porch. Lean-to roof over the terrace across the left gable end. Decorative white king-post trusses in the gable peaks.

largeGlazing.what: two-pane sliding terrace doors of the living room, about 3.2-3.7 m wide, under the terrace roof; spans roughly 0.43-0.75 of the gable wall (centre, reaching into the right third as seen from outside)

uncertain: Depth is not published. Scaling the ground plan with the published 17,55 m front length gives about 9.4 m front-to-back for the main body (plus ~0.5 m kitchen bay / ~1.6 m porch projection at the front and ~2.8 m terrace roof on the left end). Estimate only.
Building height is not given anywhere.

FRONT storey 1: the balcony door sits in a gabled wall dormer that is flush with the front wall; it is counted here as a storey-1 facade opening AND the gable is listed as a DORMER feature. Under a strict 'dormer windows are features' reading the FRONT storey-1 count would be 0.

FRONT storey 0, left to right: tall two-leaf living/dining window (~1.9 m, floor-to-ceiling, directly below the cross gable), kitchen bay window, entrance door (recessed under the porch roof), one double-width (~5 m) garage door.

LEFT storey 0 (under the terrace roof), seen from outside left to right: two-leaf floor-to-ceiling glazed door of the study (~1.7 m), then the living-room sliding glazing. LEFT storey 1: two two-sash gable windows.

RIGHT storey 0, left (front) to right (rear): side pane of the kitchen corner bay (set back inside the entrance porch, on the main body's wall, facing right) and a horizontal two-pane strip window in the garage gable wall. RIGHT storey 1: one narrow tall window in the main-body gable (bathroom) and a triangular multi-pane window in the garage gable (storage attic).
REAR: only two small glass-block windows (ground-floor WC and boiler room), at CENTRE and RIGHT thirds as seen from outside.
Entrance door centre is at ~0.58 of the enclosed front wall length (CENTRE); the garage door occupies the RIGHT third.
The elevation sheet (010) is small and its four views carry no labels; the assignment of views to facades was done by matching them against the plans and renders.
confidence: MEDIUM - plans, four small unlabelled elevations and two renders agree, but the elevations are low resolution, depth and height are not published, and the frame had to be derived from a rotated plan.
